Note: This product cannot be used without Dragon's Dogma 2. Also, if needed, please update to the latest patch before playing. Note: There are other set products which include this product. Please be aware of duplicate purchases. Your unwritten epic begins. Dragon's Dogma 2 presented players with a deep, explorable fantasy world, challenging them to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more. With Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen, that experience has been further enhanced through the addition of unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters. Experience enhanced gameplay. Embark on uncharted adventures. Enticing value for myriad additions. Together with your loyal Pawns, set off on an unparalleled adventure! Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - New Content 1. New Stories Await in a Brand-New Area Forsaken Dominion: Another Tale of Ruin Unfolds in the Snowy North Adventure forth to the long-abandoned region of Norgan and join forces with the enigmatic Eir, who seeks to unravel the secrets of the undying Fallen Dragon. Unearth and appraise forgotten relics to unlock powerful new weapons and skills that will aid you on your journey. 2. New Challenges in the Main Area Lost Rites: Prove Yourself with 12 Dungeon Challenges Rare equipment once held by past Arisens lays dormant in the depths of freshly uncovered unique dungeons. Whether you want to sharpen your skills or lay claim to legendary treasures—test your mettle against the Pathfinder's trials. 3. More Variation in the Character Creator New Hairstyles and Tattoos: Bring Your Characters to Life Craft your Arisen and Pawns with precision using the new options added to the robust Character Creator. Find the style right for you and embark on a fresh new adventure. *Ray tracing is not supported on XBOX Series S.Show morePublished byCAPCOM CO., LTD.Developed byCAPCOM CO., LTD.Release date10/9/2026Play withXBOX Series X|SIn this bundleDragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen: Norgan Fashion Set - Northern AttireView add-onDragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen ExpansionView add-onWorks withDragon's Dogma 2$39.99+Included inDragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen$49.99+ XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
